name: Caisse Regionale de Credit Agricole Mutuel Nord de France Societe cooperative
summary: Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Nord de France Société coopérative operates as a regional bank in France. It offers saving accounts, cards, real estate investment, and pension savings; auto and two-wheeler, home, life, personal, leisure and daily, and borrower insurance; and real estate and consumer credit services. Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Nord de France Société coopérative was founded in 1894 and is based in Lille, France.
